structure_explanation.en: The topic この味噌 (this miso) is marked by は and functions as the natural subject in pt-BR. Then comes the adverb 少し (a little) modifying the i-adjective 甘い (sweet), and です closes the sentence, giving a polite tone. ops.issue: The note on まし calls た a 'particle' ('partícula' in pt-BR); た is the past-tense auxiliary (助動詞), and the very next token correctly labels it 'auxiliar de passado'. Wrong term in both en and pt-BR notes.

The fix leaked an editorial/QA annotation into learner-facing English text. After: "the まし form of the auxiliary ます, base for the auxiliary た (pt: 'base para o auxiliar た')". The parenthetical "(pt: '…')" is a cross-language patch instruction, not content; it must never reach a learner-facing note.

The op explicitly covers both languages ("Wrong term in both en and pt-BR notes"), but the pt-BR note is byte-identical before and after and still calls た a particle: "forma まし do auxiliar ます, base para a partícula た".
